# PromptShield

> In-browser AI Data Loss Prevention (DLP) and Prompt Firewall extension (Manifest V3) preventing secret, credential & PII leaks into ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini.

Maintained by RitualDev Lab (https://ritualdev.in).

## Official Web Application
Live In-Browser Playground: https://ritualdev.in/promptshield

## Core Capabilities
- **Sub-2ms Evaluation**: Zero latency impact on developer workflow. Evaluates prompt input fields with high-performance regex DFA patterns and Shannon entropy scoring.
- **Zero Cloud Leakage**: 100% client-side offline evaluation. Prompts and secrets never leave the developer's workstation.
- **Sensitive Entity Detection**: Detects AWS keys, Stripe keys, GitHub PATs, private SSH/RSA keys, database connection strings, JWTs, and HIPAA/GDPR PII (SSN, national IDs, credit cards).
- **Automated Redaction & Masking**: Real-time redaction options (`[REDACTED_STRIPE_KEY]`) with reversible local token mapping.

## Quickstart
```bash
npx @ritualdev/promptshield scan "check this key sk_live_demo"
```
